data.text: **Question:** What is the difference between interface and abstract class?
An interface defines a contract without implementation. An abstract class can provide partial implementation and state.
Interfaces define what a class can do (contract). Abstract classes provide base behavior with some implementation. A class can implement multiple interfaces but inherit only one class.
